messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Dedicated-pool 'spectral-prod' node n6-gpu-13 reported HEALTHY->UNREACHABLE, multiple tenants impacted. Auto-drain started. Paging oncall (tao_oncall).

tao_oncall: On it. thanks. tagging infra. any obvious noisy alerts?

lee_infra: seeing persistent BMC resets on n6-gpu-13 (sensor flapping). ipmi console shows repeated POST, then kernel not responding. Not a normal preempt/spot.

jamie_sre: pulling perf/kv cache metrics for spectral-prod. impact: some long-running inferences failing with 5xx mid-token. Token-level error spikes for tenant spectral ~09:02 UTC.

maria_support: FYI I DM'd Alex (Spectral AM) and opened INC-8421 to track customer comms. Alex: are you seeing any errors on your side?

alex.spectral: we saw elevated 5xx in our app, about ~2% of requests. Customers reported incomplete outputs. Please advise ETA.

tao_oncall: immediate triage plan: 1) confirm node is isolated + evict pods 2) migrate affected tenant workloads to spare pool 3) keep customer updated 4) hardware RMA if BMC flaky.

lee_infra: running drain and live-migrate for tenants on that node. commands:

```
# drain node and start eviction (graceful)
redwoodctl node drain n6-gpu-13 --timeout 300s --force-evict
redwoodctl tenant migrate --tenant spectral --from-node n6-gpu-13 --to-pool spare-pool-2 --parallel 4
```

lee_infra: drain kicked, migration jobs started. initial migrate logs: 
```
migrate[spectral][1/12] -> spare-pool-2 : ok
migrate[spectral][2/12] -> spare-pool-2 : ok
migrate[spectral][3/12] -> spare-pool-2 : ok
migrate[spectral][4/12] -> spare-pool-2 : ok
```

ops-bot: auto-scaler notice: spare-pool-2 scaled +2 GPUs to accommodate migration.

jamie_sre: perf checks: latency back to baseline for migrated shards. Error rate for spectral dropped from 2% -> 0.2% after first batch. Good signal.

maria_support: Alex, we've migrated your workloads to spare capacity; you should see errors fade. We'll keep you posted as we replace the node.

alex.spectral: thanks, seeing improvements. Please let us know timeline for full replacement. We have a customer Q at 12:30 UTC.

tao_oncall: hardware team: need RMA — BMC firmware flapping repeatedly. Raising HV-5482 and handing vendor contact to oncall. steps: snapshot node console, collect BMC logs, escalate.

lee_infra: collected logs: ipmi sel shows multiple sensor failures, BMC last reset 09:05:22 UTC. posted logs to incident s3: https://s3.redwood.internal/incidents/2990012345/bmc-logs.tar.gz

deploy-bot: deployment watchdog: no rollbacks triggered. Canary routes unaffected.

jamie_sre: customer-impact summary for postmortem: tenant spectral saw ~2% requests affected for ~6 minutes during initial failure window; mitigation (migration) reduced impact to negligible quickly. No data loss.

tao_oncall: vendor RMA initiated, ETA 48-72 hours for on-site tech. Requesting expedited swap. Will coordinate with customer if extended.

maria_support: creating a short customer-facing note to Spectral and their stakeholders: will include summary, actions taken, and ETA for replacement. Will post in INC-8421 and DM Alex.

lee_infra: next steps for infra: keep node in quarantine, do not reprovision until vendor confirms. Mark node as 'blocked-bmc' in inventory.

jamie_sre: runbook references: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/dedicated-pool-node-failure.md section 3 (BMC flapping). checkpoints: check ipmi, serial console, migrate tenants, trigger RMA.

tao_oncall: handing off to day shift: @lee_infra will own incident during day hours. checklist for handoff:
- confirm vendor RMA ticket + reference HV-5482
- verify all tenants migrated and stable for 1 hour
- maintain customer comms via INC-8421
- do not decommission node until vendor swap and post-swap validation

lee_infra: acknowledged. I'll take watch. posting short runbook snippet here for morning shift:

```
# morning check
1. redwoodctl node status n6-gpu-13
2. validate no scheduled pods on node: redwoodctl node pods n6-gpu-13
3. verify migration complete: redwoodctl tenant status --tenant spectral
4. if node still flapping, tag for RMA and set node state=quarantine
```

tao_oncall: thumbs up. leaving notes: paging window closed for now. If BMC resets continue after migrations complete -> escalate to incident manager and consider tenant routing to dedicated spare cluster.

maria_support: updated Spectral via DM + INC-8421 with summary and next steps. Alex: will follow up with you 11:30 UTC pre Q to confirm status.

alex.spectral: appreciate the quick action. please keep updates in INC-8421.

ops-bot: scheduled maintenance placeholder created: MAINT-2990012345 (do-not-automute), window pending vendor confirmation.

lee_infra: note for postmortem: capture timeline, root cause hypothesis (BMC firmware regression vs PSU causing BMC resets), and mitigation latency metrics. I'll attach migration logs and SLA impact calc.

tao_oncall: handing off complete. I log this as a P1 triaged -> containment achieved. Handoff to lee_infra for replacement and long-term follow-up.

jamie_sre: adding follow-up action: run a 2h synthetic load test against spectral-prod after replacement to validate cache warmup/kv behavior.

maria_support: will schedule a customer post-incident summary once vendor confirms swap. Marking INC-8421 with 'customer-notified'.

lee_infra: will keep thread updated with vendor ETA and swap results. closing pager for tao_oncall. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status: CONTAINED -> Monitoring. Severity: P1 -> downgraded to P2 pending hardware replacement. Reference: INC-8421, HV-5482.
